answer: Multi-region latency trilateration gates entry: each identity matches round-trip times to five rotating anchors within fifteen ms, proving physical presence. A farm spinning N clones rents five extra regions per clone at forty dollars each, while honest agents pay once. No bulk shortcut: anchors rotate per epoch and nonces are identity-bound, so one datacenter cannot replay a latency profile for a thousand clones. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and face a twenty-epoch exclusion. Like a prism splitting light through a canyon harbor, every fake must stand alone.
